description: Models input bindings as reusable, observable key-map lists and provides registry, translation, rebinding, and active-input helpers.

Client/InputKeyMapListUtils.luau.description: Client side utility helpers for observing input modes for the current client. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapListUtils.getNewInputModeTypeSelector`, `InputKeyMapListUtils.observeActiveInputKeyMap`, `InputKeyMapListUtils.observeActiveInputTypesList`, `InputKeyMapListUtils.observeActiveInputModeType`.

InputKeyMapService.luau.description: Input Key Map Service provides the service implementation used by the Inputkeymaputils package. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapService.Init`.

InputKeyMapServiceClient.luau.description: Input Key Map Service Client provides the service implementation used by the Inputkeymaputils package. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapServiceClient.Init`, `InputKeyMapServiceClient.FindInputKeyMapList`, `InputKeyMapServiceClient.Destroy`.

Shared/HoldableInputModel.luau.description: Tracks hold state for an input. Handles the timing logic and exposes observables for hold progress. Public entry points include `HoldableInputModel.new`, `HoldableInputModel.SetMaxHoldDuration`, `HoldableInputModel.GetMaxHoldDuration`, `HoldableInputModel.ObserveMaxHoldDuration`, `HoldableInputModel.ObserveHoldPercent`, `HoldableInputModel.GetHoldPercent`, `HoldableInputModel.ObserveIsHolding`,…

Shared/InputKeyMap.luau.description: This represents a list of key bindings for a specific mode. While this is a useful object to query for showing icons and input hints to the user, in general, it is recommended that binding occur at the list level instead of at the input mode level. That way, if the user switches to another input mode then input is immediately processed.

Shared/InputKeyMapList.luau.description: An input key map list provides a mapping of input modes to input keys. One of these should generally exist per an action with unique bindings. All inputs should be bound while this action is active. We can further query inputs per an input mode to display only relevant key bindings to the user.

Shared/InputKeyMapListProvider.luau.description: Centralizes input of keys. You can construct a new provider in a package and key bindings can be recovered from it. This is designed for user configuration/rebindings. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapListProvider.new`, `InputKeyMapListProvider.Init`, `InputKeyMapListProvider.Start`, `InputKeyMapListProvider.GetProviderName`, `InputKeyMapListProvider.GetInputKeyMapList`,…

Shared/InputKeyMapRegistryServiceShared..description: Provides retrieval of input key maps across the game. Available on both the client and the server. Input key maps are needed on the server to bind datastore settings. Public entry points include `InputKeyMapRegistryServiceShared.Init`, `InputKeyMapRegistryServiceShared.RegisterProvider`, `InputKeyMapRegistryServiceShared.ObserveProvidersBrio`, `InputKeyMapRegistryServiceShared.ObserveInputKeyMapListsBrio`,…

Shared/InputKeyMapTranslator.luau.description: Input Key Map Translator provides the module implementation used by the Inputkeymaputils package.

Shared/ProximityPromptInputUtils.luau.description: Utility functions to configure a proximity prompt based upon the input key map given. Public entry points include `ProximityPromptInputUtils.newInputKeyMapFromPrompt`, `ProximityPromptInputUtils.configurePromptFromInputKeyMap`, `ProximityPromptInputUtils.getFirstInputKeyCode`.

Shared/Types/InputChordUtils.luau.description: Standardized data type to define an input chord, such as Ctrl+Z. Public entry points include `InputChordUtils.isModifierInputChord`, `InputChordUtils.createModifierInputChord`.

Shared/Types/InputTypeUtils.luau.description: Utility functions for input type classification and comparison. Public entry points include `InputTypeUtils.isKnownInputType`, `InputTypeUtils.isTapInWorld`, `InputTypeUtils.isDrag`, `InputTypeUtils.isRobloxTouchButton`, `InputTypeUtils.createTapInWorld`, `InputTypeUtils.createRobloxTouchButton`, `InputTypeUtils.getUniqueKeyForInputType`, `convertValuesToJSONIfNeeded`.

Shared/Types/SlottedTouchButtonUtils.lua.description: Slotted Touch Button Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Inputkeymaputils package. Public entry points include `SlottedTouchButtonUtils.createSlottedTouchButton`, `SlottedTouchButtonUtils.isSlottedTouchButton`, `SlottedTouchButtonUtils.createTouchButtonData`, `SlottedTouchButtonUtils.getSlottedTouchButtonData`.
